metadata.description: Compass 1.0 — describe what you want, read one page, say yes four times, get a product that does what the page says, proven live. One command, four stages, attacks instead of review rounds.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: One command inside Claude Code: /compass. A product interview draws an Idea page you can read in a minute; the plan the best teams write, on one screen; a build proven step by step; fresh reviewers attack every promise (held or broke, two attempts, no rounds); deploy writes the live numbers back onto your page. Build to spec: nothing is built the page does not say.
